summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for bounded reversible growth. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and authorize no public beta, affiliate/advertising expansion, alert expansion, or external permission outreach until human-counsel review and all technical, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates are complete. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal data; current terms restrict commercial/public reuse. Fleet compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; analytics has yellow source gaps; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and unattributed. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Progress consists of official Woot/API/terms/support artifacts, repository/configuration evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft public terms. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data: counsel_required. Missing evidence is written permission or an API agreement plus field-level rights for prices, images, trademarks, historical derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, affiliate, and advertising use. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing evidence is the actual data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing evidence is deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing evidence is the log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor or DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Site and checklist disposition: retain complicated.work blocked pending remediation of evidenced banner/consent failures and GA4 failure; retain deadlymaracas.com private/parked because DNS reachability and compliance evidence are unknown; do not infer adult, age-sensitive, or NSFW status from domain names. Do not treat incomplete analytics or revenue telemetry as zero. Affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, privacy, terms, cookie/analytics disclosure, and age-sensitive issues require site-specific evidence before monetization or launch.

Maintain containment-only execution for legal scope. Continue only existing legal evidence, security evidence, repair-or-close, measurement, and matching-period attribution/cost reconciliation work. Do not create or requeue production work, enable tracking, change monetization, deploy, spend, expand alerts, or conduct outreach. Revenue remains aggregate and unattributed; no ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal-lift claim is supported.
